content_sections.heading: SGPGIMS Project Technical Support-III at a Glance

rows.details: Sanjay Gandhi Post-Graduate Institute of Medical Sciences
Department of Hematology / Stem Cell Research Center
Therapeutic Targeting of Lymphoid-to-Myeloid Lineage Switch: An Escape Mechanism of CD19-Directed Immunotherapies
One year (may be extended depending on satisfactory performance till duration of project)
Application Last Date: 22 October 2026 / Interview Date: 26 October 2026

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential and desirable qualifications required for the Project Technical Support-III post are as follows: Essential Qualification: Three years graduate degree in relevant subject/field + three years experience in relevant area, OR Post Graduate Degree in Life Sciences subjects/Biotechnology/Biochemistry/Molecular Biology/Microbiology. Desirable Qualification: Candidates applying for the post of Project Technical Support-III may have qualified CSIR-UGC NET-LS, DBT BET-Category II or GATE or equivalent examinations. Candidates having prior research experience in the areas Molecular Modeling and Simulation, Immunological assays, Flow cytometry, Animal handling, Primary cell culture and Molecular Biology from a reputed Research Institute/University will be given preference.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The emoluments for the position are Rs. 28,000 plus 20% HRA. The initial appointment is for one year, which may be extended depending upon the satisfactory performance of the candidate till the duration of the project. The tenure of the position is coterminous with the project.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SGPGIMS Project Technical Support-III
content_sections.text: Prepare an updated CV, a cover letter, and scanned copies of self-attested supporting documents and the photograph. Combine all documents into a single PDF file. Send the application via email to [email protected] or [email protected] . Ensure the application reaches latest by 22 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection process involves an interview. The interview is scheduled for 26 October 2026 at 11:00 AM at the Conference Room, Stem Cell Research Center, Department of Hematology, SGPGIMS, Lucknow. Candidates can attend either in person or opt for a virtual/online interview. Those who opt for a virtual/online interview will be responsible for any technical difficulties.

faq.question: Q1. Is the Project Technical Support-III post permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The initial appointment is for one year and may be extended depending on satisfactory performance till the duration of the project, as the tenure is coterminous with the project.

faq.question: Q2. Are there any allowances paid in addition to the base pay?
faq.answer: Yes, the emoluments are Rs. 28,000 plus 20% HRA.

faq.question: Q3. What are the desirable qualifications given in the notice?
faq.answer: Desirable qualifications include having qualified CSIR-UGC NET-LS, DBT BET-Category II or GATE or equivalent examinations, and prior research experience in Molecular Modeling and Simulation, Immunological assays, Flow cytometry, Animal handling, Primary cell culture, and Molecular Biology.

faq.question: Q4. What documents must be sent with the email application?
faq.answer: Applicants must send an updated CV, a cover letter, and self-attested supporting documents along with a scanned photograph, all compiled in a single PDF file.
